purpose: Pre-register the ARN v2 deterministic reducer successor before touching confirmatory data. All parameters, thresholds, and abstention rules are frozen here.
successor_description: ARN v2 deterministic reducer with typed extraction, partial-credit mapping, and principled abstention. NO language model, NO network, deterministic rules only.
author: RAKL programme (same-context; LLM-assisted)

role_selection.method: top-k by frequency, with syntactic role typing
role_selection.selection_criteria: frequency (primary), alphabetical tie-break (secondary), same as parent

syntactic_roles.subject_heuristic: First capitalized token in sentence (position 0 or first after sentence-start punctuation) that passes content-token filter
syntactic_roles.object_heuristic: Content token within distance 2 of verb-like tokens (verbs: copulas, action markers) and not at sentence start
syntactic_roles.oblique_heuristic: Content token following prepositions (after, in, on, at, by, for, with, from, to, under, over, between, against, during, without)
syntactic_roles.default_role: If no heuristic matches, token is untyped (role_type = null)

entity_type_hints.PERSON: Capitalized token matching person pronouns (he, she, him, her, his, their, who, someone, anyone) or near person markers (man, woman, person, people, child, boy, girl)
entity_type_hints.PLACE: Content token near place markers (here, there, where, city, country, house, room, place, location, area, region)

relation_typing.CAUSAL: Markers: because, therefore, thus, hence, so, consequently, as a result
relation_typing.ENABLE: Markers: if, when, whenever, provided that, assuming
relation_typing.TEMPORAL: Markers: before, after, while, during, until, since, as soon as, once
relation_typing.SIMILARITY: Markers: like, similar to, unlike, compared to, resembles

negation_scope.scope_rule: A relation is negated if any negation marker appears between the two role tokens in the sentence (inclusive window). Relations extracted from sentences containing negation markers are marked with negated=true, obstructions cover the involved roles.
negation_scope.obstruction_rule: Same as parent: sentence with >=2 role tokens and any negation marker emits obstruction covering those roles.

abstraction.description: No additional abstraction level beyond flat SupportStructure (same as parent). Relation typing provides lightweight semantic structure without full hierarchical abstraction.

mapping.description: Type-preserving correspondence score with bonus for matching role types and penalty for type mismatches. Score is normalized to [0, 1].

score_components.type_bonus: 0.2 per role where both query and candidate have same non-NONE role_type
score_components.type_penalty: -0.1 per role where role_type mismatch (both non-NONE but different)
score_components.relation_type_bonus: 0.15 per relation where both have same non-PLAIN relation_type

mapping.theta_w_fit: DEV grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.05, maximize decidable exact accuracy (same as parent)
mapping.acceptance_rule: ACCEPT iff normalized_score >= theta_w, else REJECT

CANNOT_CHECK_conditions.rule: query has < 2 roles OR 0 relations OR candidate has < 2 roles OR 0 relations (same as parent floor)
fraction of typed roles (role_type != NONE) in query < 0.2 AND fraction of typed relations (relation_type != PLAIN) < 0.1
normalized mapping score < theta_w AND (role_coverage == 0 OR relation_coverage == 0), i.e., poor alignment even before threshold

abstention.rationale: Principled abstention when extraction is too sparse (few typed elements) or mapping is too weak (no significant overlap). This addresses the parent's NOT_USED deficit where CANNOT_CHECK rate was 0.0 despite poor performance.

admission.sample_sources: the query texts of the first 8 groups in frozen split order (same as parent)

primary_levers: typed extraction adds semantic signal (subject/object/oblique, relation types)
partial-credit mapping rewards type matches instead of raw coverage
principled abstention avoids forced decisions on uncertain mappings
revival_strategy.hypothesis: Typed extraction + type-preserving mapping + abstention will capture more analogical structure than raw lexical co-occurrence, leading to higher confirmatory accuracy.

evaluation.scoring: same Brier scoring, same bootstrap CI, same G1/G2/G3 gates as parent protocol

nonclaims: independent review (same-context analysis over third-party labels)
